integrity: Exact finite Gram certificates and analytic all-degree representation containment proof, with a standalone standard-library checker. No assertion of independent verification.
scientific_limitations: Exact-degree rank and Gram spectra on the twenty order-three rotations only; no uniqueness of interpolation coefficients for large degrees, no optimal node selection theorem, and no independent mathematical audit. Potential equivalent earlier icosahedral sampling formula is a bounded originality risk.
title: A degree-three interpolation blackout on twenty icosahedral rotations
